evidence.summary: Palettes contrast-checked with the WCAG 2.1 relative-luminance formula. All four pass 4.5:1 for text_primary and text_muted on their surfaces and for window_background as label text on an accent fill, and 3.0:1 for accent/warning/success/danger on panel_background. Nord's canonical aurora red #BF616A reached only 2.46:1 on #3B4252, so Nordic Slate uses the lightened #D4838C (3.56:1).
